no-mine.label: Chennai Super Kings' openers' strike rate, 2024–2026
no-mine.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
no-mine.query: WITH appear AS ( SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts), op AS (SELECT innings_id, pid FROM pos WHERE position <= 2) SELECT pl.name, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM op JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = op.innings_id AND d.batter_id = op.pid JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = op.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = op.pid WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name, mine
